motivation: Pinned Torch _pytree probes optree via importlib.util.find_spec; strict unknown-root exception prevents ordinary optional absence behavior
entry_prerequisites: Single dedicated process, no concurrent or nested wrapping
Exact fixed search paths, unchanged original util.find_spec identity
No cached optree or optree submodule
Fresh absence check across all fixed search paths; present spec refuses rather than imports
No generic missing-module or optional-prefix exception
implementation_boundary: Exact util.find_spec wrapper, not finder None fallthrough. Nonmatching name/arguments delegate original behavior. Restore original on normal and exceptional exit.
required_tests: Exact fresh absent optree probe returns None
Direct import optree rejects with no later finder touched
Submodule, similar root and relative name receive no exception
Cached optree or submodule refuses before entry
Present spec in any fixed path refuses before ML
Normal and exception cleanup restores exact original function
claim_boundary: Finite design only. Absence under controlled paths is not global physical absence or dependency-content sealing. A new remote execution scope is required after implementation, full tests and independent review.
